about: Public explorer labels for Plasma (chain 9745) addresses that Plasma One transfers go to, used to name rows (e.g. a card settlement address). Only labels published by a public explorer, each with its source URL. Empty on 8 Oct 2026: no public label for a Plasma One card settlement address was found, so rows use the generic 'Plasma One payment · 0x12…ab34' and the page explains why.
